{{Otheruses|Analysis}}
An '''analysis kit''' was an internal feature of the [[Explorer Mk. V]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. Used in conjunction with its internal storage capability, the analysis kit could determine the composition and value of minerals.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts">[[Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts]]</ref>
